profile.headline: Software Engineer at Handshake
profile.summary:
I’m a software engineer with a passion for building scalable, user-centered products. With experience across the full stack, from crafting responsive frontends in React to developing robust backends in Python and Kotlin. I thrive at the intersection of thoughtful design and clean code. I enjoy collaborating cross-functionally, solving complex problems, and continuously learning new technologies to drive impact.

Let’s connect!

positions.title: Professional development
positions.description:
Took time away from full-time work to focus on family, travel, and personal well-being.

Dedicated significant time to upskilling in modern web application development and data analysis tooling, including Python, full-stack architecture, data workflows, and building interactive, browser-based analytics features.

Built a data analysis application as a solo project, applying real datasets, ETL workflows, and analytics tooling.

Returned refreshed and focused, actively seeking opportunities to contribute technical depth, product thinking, and strong engineering practices to a new team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed Personalized Learning Experiences: Designed and implemented React components using TypeScript and Django to deliver tailored Course and Learning Path Recommendations, boosting active learning days.

Improved Developer Productivity: Built internal tools and streamlined development workflows by creating reusable frontend libraries and APIs, reducing time-to-market for new features and ensuring consistent user experiences across platforms.

Implemented Data-Driven Insights: Enriched Amplitude analytics by updating a Spark pipeline in Scala, enabling deeper understanding of user engagement and supporting data-driven decision-making.

Optimized Backend Systems: Developed microservices in Kotlin with Hibernate and Spring Boot, implemented Kafka-based messaging systems, and utilized gRPC to ensure real-time data migration and dual-write capabilities.

Streamlined Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partnered with product, design, and engineering teams to define technical requirements, resolve complex integration challenges, and deliver high-quality user experiences on Udemy’s platform.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · SQL · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Web Development

projects.title: COVID Ready
projects.description:
Find and rate medical clinics on their COVID readiness.

COVID Ready is a crowd sourced application that addresses patient anxieties surrounding clinic COVID readiness and ensures that medical clinics are adhering to COVID guidelines. Users can rate medical clinics based on their COVID readiness through a 5 star rating system and see other user reviews to make better health decisions.

COVID Ready utilizes Google Maps and Places API to render the map and medical clinic information. The app is built using Flask with SQLAlchemy as the ORM and React for the frontend.

projects.title: Women in Tech Analysis
projects.description:
For this project, I received Hackbright Academy's Phenomenal Woman Scholarship.

I recently started learning Python and wanted to use my new skills to explore data science, since the topic has always been interesting to me. I chose this project because I wanted to learn techniques that data scientists use to visualize large datasets. As a woman who recently took up programming herself, I wanted to see which languages other women were learning.

This project leverages Jupyter notebooks to analyze HackerRank's Developer Survey 2018 dataset. Utilizes Pandas pivot/melt libraries to manipulate data frames for future plotting and visualized data with Seaborn and Matplotlib.
